capabilities: Create and edit mind maps stored as .ksmm files in the vault
Navigate, reorder, and reparent nodes with keyboard, mouse, and touch controls
Organize branches with groups, colors, focus mode, collapse, and locking
Import and export Markdown, OPML, JSON, .ksmm, images, and PDFs
Arrange maps with tree, radial, staggered, and linear layouts
extras: README states the plugin collects no data and makes no network requests; presentation PDF export requires Obsidian desktop's native PDF renderer; maps from 0.1.x/0.2.x beta releases are normalized when opened.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dedicated mind-mapping tool with hierarchical layouts, keyboard-driven node editing, and structured import/export of mind maps.
summary: File-based mind-mapping plugin that builds hierarchical maps in a canvas-style view with keyboard, mouse, and touch input, multiple layouts, and import/export.
